b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a
file of your choice, or to stdout.

## Usage

```
tinydl [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [-q] url
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` (positional) | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
| `-h`, `--help` | show this help message and exit |

## Example

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
```
'
